During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a '''stronghold''' on the astronomical object [[Polomie]]. It was [[Battle of Polomie|attacked]] by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force containing a [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis''-class gunship]].<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "[[Nemesis-class gunship|The ''Nemesis'' Gunship]]" databank entry}}</ref>
